messages:
Priya (Procurement): looping in finance + eng. OrchidLedger sent a proposal for a credits-based billing model for inference metering. main asks: token<>credit mapping, sequence multipliers, rollover, and invoice line detail for AP.
Amelia (Finance): skimmed the proposal. they quote credits, not tokens. need deterministic conversion and an example invoice we can feed to our parser. also payment terms 30 pilot net-45 preferred.
Jon S (Eng Ops): our POC consumed ~1.2M inference tokens and ~48k embeddings. any short example of how that maps? also worried about long-context blowup.
Marco - OrchidLedger: thanks all. baseline mapping: 1 credit = 1k inference tokens OR 12 embedding units. we apply a per-request sequence multiplier: 1-1k tokens = 1x, 1k-4k = 1.8x, 4k-8k = 2.6x. multipliers are applied to tokens_out only.
Sasha R (Platform): tokens_out only? curious why not tokens_in as wellfor streaming decoders tokens_out matter but encoder-heavy calls differ.
Marco - OrchidLedger: good catch. we actually compute billable_tokens = tokens_in * 0.2 + tokens_out * 1.0 to approximate compute cost; then apply multiplier. will include formula and sample calc.
Priya (Procurement): rollover policy? previous vendor zeroed unused quarterly and that hurt forecasts.
Marco - OrchidLedger: two choices: quarterly commits with 40% rollover, or annual commits with full rollover and a small maintenance fee. unused credits expire after 24 months otherwise.
Amelia (Finance): sample invoice lines? need fields like invoice_id, period, commit_amount, used_credits, overage_credits, unit_price, tax, total.
Marco - OrchidLedger: sample invoice preview: "INV-2026-ORC-042: Quarterly commit 150,000 credits @ $0.30 = $45,000; Overage 10,450 credits @ $0.30 = $3,135; Setup (Private VPC) = $7,500; Tax = $3,214; Total = $58,849". will attach CSV and PDF.
Jon S (Eng Ops): can you stream per-request logs to our S3 with request_id, model_variant, tokens_in, tokens_out, billable_tokens, timestamp? we need per-route cost mapping.
Marco - OrchidLedger: yes  s3 push or signed url. logs include billable_tokens computed as above.
Sasha R (Platform): security: SOC2, ISO27001? BYOK for private? we require CKMS for enterprise.
Marco - OrchidLedger: SOC2 Type II and ISO27001 in process. BYOK supported via AWS KMS and bring-your-own-HSM for private installs.
Priya (Procurement): setup fee is $7.5k in SOW. negotiable?
Marco - OrchidLedger: can reduce to $3.5k with a 12-month annual commit.
Amelia (Finance): also need to confirm refund/termination: pro-rata refund windows on annual?
Marco - OrchidLedger: annual contracts pro-rata refund if terminated with >9 months remaining, 30-day notice for shorter pilots with no refund. open to specific CAR (customer acceptance) clauses.
Priya (Procurement): Accounting Bot  please run the mock invoice once Marco uploads CSV and flag any AP parser mismatches.
Accounting Bot: ready. drop the CSV link and I will run a dry parse and return field mapping diffs.
Jon S (Eng Ops): one more: do you offer discounted "background" credits for non-urgent batch at lower price? that would help for nightly featurization.
Marco - OrchidLedger: yes  background credits (best-effort) at 45% off standard rate, tagged in logs as "background" and cannot be applied to low-latency routes.
Sasha R (Platform): ok next steps I suggest: 1) Marco uploads multiplier table + CSV mock invoice, 2) Accounting Bot runs parser, 3) Amelia confirms pilot net-45 budget, 4) Jon runs our 1.2M token sample through their logging format. ack please.
Amelia (Finance): ack  will confirm budget by EOD tomorrow.
Jon S (Eng Ops): ack  will test logs and post parsing issues.
Sasha R (Platform): ack  will validate BYOK path and background credit tagging.
Marco - OrchidLedger: thanks all  I'll upload the multiplier matrix and invoice samples in ~45m. holding the $3.5k setup concession for 72hrs. available for 30m sync if helpful. :handshake:
Accounting Bot: mock invoice queued for parse upon upload  will post results in ~1.5hrs.
